verdict.rationale: Typesense publishes an official MCP server page for Typesense Cloud. It says a connected agent can create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics from the conversation [typesense-docs-43]. Users choose the agent's permissions at connect time and can disconnect at any time [typesense-docs-52], and the docs also include a 'Typesense for AI Agents' guide [typesense-docs-17]. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, no evidence of an MCP server for self-hosted open-source deployments (only Typesense Cloud is evidenced), and thin detail on setup and transport.
